choice: A Python helper serves a page on 127.0.0.1:47801; a browser tab in the global Dock (one per window, kept across workspace switches) shows it, and the helper runs in a background terminal tab of the same Dock pane.
consequences: Needs a long-running helper inside cmux. The page shows cmux's browser toolbar unless the tab is seeded from dock.json with chrome:false.
context: The panel must list Linear issues for the selected cmux workspace without displacing cmux's native workspace list in the left sidebar.
rejected: 1) CmuxExtensionKit sidebar extension: a working signed probe was built and abandoned (see the record on ExtensionKit). 2) Interpreted custom sidebar (~/.config/cmux/sidebars/*.js|.swift, can sit in the right panel): no network, files or timers; outside data arrives only through workspace fields (progress, description, color, title) that the native list shows too, and `cmux set-status` never reaches it; carrier workspaces in the cmux-sentinel style would clutter the list. 3) Terminal UI in a Dock terminal: simplest, but text-only. 4) One status pill or progress bar per workspace in the native list via set-status/set-progress: too little room for an issue list.
title: Show the Linear panel as a local web page in the cmux right-sidebar Dock
